name: PROxyLLM Console Design System
description: The design system of the PROxyLLM console: a dark-only operational interface on a near-black canvas with one green accent for health and action, glass surfaces, Plus Jakarta Sans headings over Inter body text, and JetBrains Mono for numbers. Coupled to DESIGN.md; colors_and_type.css holds the values.

light.reason: Dark is the only appearance: html{color-scheme:dark} and the color-scheme meta tag pin the document, so the canvas, form controls and scrollbars stay dark even when the browser asks for light. Nothing in the console reads prefers-color-scheme. A light appearance would be a separate token layer with its own bg/surface/fg/muted/border/accent; inverting these values is not this system.

surface.role: glass card, widget, table and pill surface + blur(10px)

surface-elevated.role: modal, drawer, user menu, toast backing

muted.role: secondary text: nav, captions, help text, table meta

accent.role: action, focus, links, healthy status, the sidebar dot

accent-dim.role: soft accent fill: chips, icon circles, menu hover

400.role: lighter end of the primary-button gradient

800.role: dropdown and card borders, ring track

600.role: hover borders, button borders, breadcrumb separators

info.role: informational: sub-operations, capability fallbacks, image captions

chart-2.role: comparison series — neutral, never a second accent

rail.role: request-log tree rail: parent to sub-operation

text.role: resting colour of a number inside a data cell

bg-elev.role: achromatic wash marking a moved row

display.role: headings, page titles, KPI values, wordmark

body.role: body text, tables, forms, buttons, nav

mono.role: numbers, ids, client keys, timestamps, pills

gradients.primary-hover: white overlay gradient over the primary gradient

motion.status_ping: 2s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite — sidebar live dot, healthy status dot
motion.running_dot: 1.2s ease-in-out infinite — a request still in flight
motion.spinner: 0.9s linear infinite — a route chunk that has not loaded
motion.reduced_motion: every duration is neutralised under prefers-reduced-motion, and the ping and the spinner are switched off; the label alone carries the state

z_index.note: Only the two layers more than one rule needs are tokens; the others are set once, in the rule that owns them.

fonts.note: All three families are declared with @font-face in the token layer and render in the console: Inter and Plus Jakarta Sans, and JetBrains Mono at 400 and 500. Switching a family on or off re-lays out everything it renders and therefore moves the committed Playwright screenshot baselines.

posture: Operational and plain: the console reports, it does not sell.
Concrete: a number is shown with its unit, or it is absent.
Honest: a missing value is an em dash or an empty state, never a plausible-looking placeholder.
Calm: no exclamation marks, no urgency, no marketing verbs.
patterns: Sentence case for headings, labels and nav ('Client keys', 'Account settings', 'Models & Compatibility').
Imperative, one-word buttons where possible ('Sign in', 'Cancel', 'Test'), with the action named in full when it is destructive ('Change password').
Empty state = a short title plus one sentence that says what would put something there ('No client keys', 'No model traffic' / 'Requests appear here once models serve traffic.').
Loading states name what is being fetched ('Loading logs', 'Fetching the latest requests.').
Numbers carry their unit and their reference ('142 ms', 'TI:', 'CR: 1,204 (38%)').
do_not: Do not invent a metric, a status or a count.
Do not use marketing language, urgency or superlatives.
Do not use emoji or an icon in place of a word.

app_shell.grid: sidebar + content; sidebar 240px (collapsed 64px), topbar 72px, then the routed page
app_shell.topbar: .topbar, sticky, glass (blur 2.5px + inset highlight), collapse toggle + account avatar

card.base: 1px solid var(--border); background var(--surface); backdrop-filter blur(10px); border-radius 12px
card.hover: border-color -> var(--neutral-600); an interactive card turns accent and takes var(--shadow-card-hover)
card.anti_pattern: No left colour stripe — the border itself is the accent surface

table.base: glass surface, sticky header, 13px/16px cells, --row-hover on hover, 2px separation by hairline
table.cells: provider and protocol render as .pill/.pill-warm, status as .badge with a coloured dot

form.field: label above; input 40px on oklch(11% 0.011 250 / 60%) with a 1px border
form.valid: subtle accent border; never a substitute for the error state

overlay.modal: .modal-backdrop (fixed, 60% black + blur 4px, z 200) with .modal centred on it (z 210, max-width 480px)
overlay.user_menu: fixed under the avatar, min-width 210px, z 170

logs.row: .log-row, one line per request: status, model, provider, protocol, account, key, tokens, TPS, latency, time
logs.child: .log-row-child under its parent, drawn with the .child-elbow tree rail on --rail, keeping the parent's column count
logs.chips: .chip/.chip-healed for a request that recovered, .pill for provider/protocol, .link-chip for an in-row action
logs.detail: .chain-summary + .chain-pill, .child-op-open per sub-operation, .raw-trace for the raw trace

load_order: 1. colors_and_type.css — tokens, @font-face, reduced motion, focus, reset
4. page-specific rules only as a composition of tokens, never a redefinition
workflow: Compose classes from the kit; copy shapes from design/examples/components.html
Colour, type, space and motion come from tokens in colors_and_type.css
Keep the token source and the runtime copy byte-identical (webui/design_sync_test.go)
Run npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build, go test ./webui/..., and the design-rule assertions
Style refactors must not move a pixel: design-rules.spec.ts green, screenshot baselines unchanged

verification.assertions: webui/e2e/design-rules.spec.ts — dark-only color-scheme, tokens-only colours (hue windows), no emoji
verification.screenshots: webui/e2e/routes.spec.ts — baselines rendered in CI only, refreshed with the update-visual-baselines workflow

anti_patterns: Never introduce a second chromatic colour — green is the accent, status tones the only other hues
Never ship a light theme or read prefers-color-scheme: light
Never override a token in a component rule — add a token instead
Never write raw colour literals outside the token and component layers
Never fabricate a metric — an em dash or an empty state instead
Never use emoji as icons — inline SVG only
Never add tracking or analytics scripts
Never use outline-only charts — encode with fills
Never put a left colour stripe on a card; the sidebar's active indicator is the one permitted left edge
Never put variable-length text on a flex-wrap line above other content
